name: Continum Freiburg data center expansion/modernization
notes: Operator says it is investing a seven-figure amount over three years to significantly expand and modernize its Freiburg data center, including cooling, redundant power, access security and fire protection; main site says Continum operates its own data centers in Germany.

name: EVF Datacenter Stauferpark Göppingen
notes: Operator describes a dedicated colocation data-center building in Stauferpark Göppingen, certified to DIN EN 50600 and ISO/IEC 27001, with room for up to 144 42U racks.

name: Heidelberg iT Wavehouse / Serverhotel IV
developer: Heidelberg iT Management GmbH & Co. KG
notes: Heidelberg iT took the keys to the Wavehouse on 2024-01-30 and said the 3D-printed building would be fitted out as a colocation data center; its current colocation page states it operates Serverhotel IV in the Wavehouse.

name: nexspace Heidelberg Innovation Park data center
notes: Nexspace lists Heidelberg as a data-center location at George-Boole-Weg 3. DCD reported the launch in Heidelberg Innovation Park with 2 MW IT load across 4,000 sqm, expandable to 8,000 sqm.

name: Rathaus Heidenheim municipal data center renovation
notes: City page identifies the project as 'Fördermittel Sanierung Rechenzentrum Rathaus Heidenheim' with grant code 67K16383; trade press says the renovated municipal data center entered service in summer 2023 and received EUR 268,036 in BMWE climate funding.

name: STACKIT Neckarsulm DC01
notes: STACKIT identifies Neckarsulm DC01 at the Schwarz Group headquarters as one of its colocation data centers. Inflect lists the Neckarsulm facility as operated by STACKIT with 4.5 MW power capacity.

name: STACKIT Ellhofen DC08
notes: STACKIT identifies Ellhofen DC08 near the Weinsberg motorway junction as one of its colocation data centers; Inflect lists the facility at Am AK 14, Ellhofen, operated by STACKIT.

name: IPAI Campus Heilbronn AI ecosystem data center component
developer: Innovation Park Artificial Intelligence (IPAI) / project partners
notes: IPAI says construction of the 30-hectare campus in Heilbronn's Steinäcker area begins from the end of 2025. Germany Trade & Invest described the planned campus as including laboratories, a data center and a start-up center.

name: Würth IT Technology Center Waldzimmern data center
notes: Würth announced the 2015 inauguration of the Waldzimmern IT technology center with 1,000 sqm of data-center space in a 5,220 sqm complex; the site forms part of the Hohenloher Ring backup network with Gaisbach and Waldenburg.

name: Fiducia / Atruvia Rheinstetten data center
notes: Trade/financial IT reporting identifies Fiducia's Rheinstetten data center as processing and storing customer data; earlier industry reporting notes solar power efficiency work at the 2007-built Rheinstetten facility.

name: TelemaxX IPC 3 Karlsruhe
notes: Operator lists IPC 3 as its first purpose-built Karlsruhe data center with 1,600 sqm data-center usable area, N+1 redundancy, ISO/IEC 27001 colocation certification and colocation by rack/cage/fire compartment.

name: TelemaxX IPC 4 Karlsruhe
notes: Operator lists IPC 4 as TelemaxX's largest data center, with 3,000 sqm data-center usable area, N+1 redundancy, 99.99% power/cooling availability and ISO/IEC 27001 colocation certification.

name: TelemaxX IPC 5 Karlsruhe
notes: Operator lists IPC 5 as a redundancy-concept data center with 2,000 sqm data-center usable area, 2N redundancy, 99.99% power/cooling availability and TÜV IT/EN50600 class 3 evidence.
